headlines.name: Texas’ school voucher program could be “unrecognizable, if not extinct,” says Democratic lawmaker
headlines.headline: Texas’ school voucher program could be “unrecognizable, if not extinct,” says Democratic lawmaker
headlines.description: Democrats won back the Texas House for the first time in 24 years. Gov. Greg Abbott’s bullishness on vouchers turned off some Republican voters in rural communities that have historically been strongholds for his party, politicians said.

sources.name: ProPublica
sources.title: Texas’ School Voucher Program Could Be “Unrecognizable, If Not Extinct,” Says Democratic Lawmaker
sources.description: Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa at a rally in Austin on Election Day. Leila Saidane for The Texas Tribune Texas Gov. Greg Abbott’s vision for education was finally coming together. This year, the state launched a voucher program that allowed roughly 110,000 of Texas’ more than 5 million schoolchildren to get a private education using taxpayer dollars.
